paragraphs: R' Shimon bar Karsana: Shekalim, chapter 4; Terumot 2:3; Ma'asrot, first chapter, halakhah 2; Hallah 4:6. R' Elazar reports in his name: Shabbat, first chapter, halakhah 1, and the end of the first chapter, 4 end of side a. See Shevi'it 9:7: “I asked those of the house of Karsana.”
